name: Just Out of Reach
benefit:
When a foe more than 5 feet away from you makes a melee attack against you using reach, you gain a +4 dodge bonus to your AC against the attack.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Armor Master's Handbook pg. 21
You can spend 5 stamina points to gain the benefits of this feat against any one melee attack. (Melee Tactics Toolbox 9)
flavor: The farther an attacker is from you, the more easily you avoid its melee attacks.
